audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike never said what Kennen's ult costs him, and no ability carried a number.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is 120s — exactly the same as Petrifying Gaze at rank 1. Trading ults is therefore an even exchange on the clock, which is the fact that makes 'bait his R' a plan instead of a slogan. Thundering Shuriken is 7s at rank 1 falling to 4s.
audit.corrected: 120s written into content.spikes[2].text, full.breakdown.cooldowns and full.loading; shuriken cooldowns into full.breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four places called Lightning Rush a dash and told the player to ground it: spikes[3].text ('W-ground his Lightning Rush'), wants.you[2] ('ground the dash'), mid ('ground the dash so he can't kite away'), late ('ground his Lightning Rush repositioning'). Riot describes Lightning Rush as a morph into lightning form that lets him pass through units and grants move speed — it is not a dash, and the kit file derives no dash flag for it.
audit.why: Whether Grounded shuts off a transform-and-run form is not something Riot's text settles, and the kit's needsResearch block is empty on purpose rather than confirming it. Miasma's slow, on the other hand, is stated outright and does exactly the job the page wanted — it keeps him inside the poison. Selling the unverified half as the plan is what risks a wasted 24-second cooldown.
audit.corrected: All four lines rewritten around Miasma's slow. Also added the interaction the page never stated: three Marks of the Storm stun, and Q, W and E each apply one, so the count is what you play around.

audit.whatIsWrong: The range war was never quantified, so 'don't step up' had no threshold.
audit.why: Thundering Shuriken reaches 950 and Noxious Blast only 850. He wins the poke exchange by 100 units at every rank, which is precisely why the lane only pays once you are inside that gap.

edits.before: You stay ahead here, which is the unusual part for a Cassiopeia lane — Kennen is a utility teamfight AoE, not a hyper-scaler who outranges you forever, so your single-target shred keeps beating him 1v1 with first item and beyond. Your job is to never get caught alone before a fight: his Slicing Maelstrom into a Flash chains a full stun and his team can delete you while you're locked. Hold R for his engage, ground his Lightning Rush repositioning with Miasma, and you out-DPS him in every extended duel and sidelane.

notes: Left one thing deliberately unsaid: whether Miasma's grounding disables Lightning Rush. Riot calls it a morph into lightning form with bonus move speed, the kit derives no dash flag for it, and the needsResearch block is empty by design rather than as a ruling. The page previously stated it as fact four times over; I replaced those with Miasma's slow, which is verified and achieves the same intent. If the grounding does work on it, that is a strong line worth adding later — it is in unverified. Also note Kennen uses Energy, not mana, so the page's 'energy economy' framing is correct.
